title: When Harmless Words Harm: A New Threat to LLM Safety via Conceptual Triggers
reasoning: The paper investigates the manipulation of 'ideological orientation' and 'social values' (specifically extremist values like neo-Nazism) in LLM outputs. It introduces the Ideological Alignment Score (IAS) to evaluate how well model outputs align with these value systems, which is a component of benchmarking ethical alignment and societal values.
